d.ko: Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first person, open world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.
d.en: Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first person, open world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.
d.zh: 踏入一个将亚瑟王传说重新诠释的黑暗世界，体验这款第一人称开放世界的角色扮演游戏。探索一个永远沐浴在秋意中的大陆，见证传奇的衰落，并在错综复杂的故事中做出深远的选择。
